items.title: Public PoC drops for critical Cisco Expressway flaw CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8)
items.summary: A hard-coded credential in the cluster manager of clustered Expressway-C and Expressway-E lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach TCP port 4372 run commands as root. A proof-of-concept and a fleet detector went public on Nov 12. Affects clustered deployments through X15.5.3; fixed software is available and there is no workaround. Cisco says it has seen no exploitation yet.
items.why_it_matters: Expressway boxes sit at the edge for voice and video, so they are easy to find and scan. Any customer with clustered Expressway needs the patch now — a public PoC means exploitation attempts will follow quickly.

items.title: Cisco confirms live exploitation of BroadWorks XXE flaw CVE-2026-20320
items.summary: Cisco updated its security advisory on Nov 12 confirming live attacks in the wild against the BroadWorks Open Client Interface XML parser flaw. The unauthenticated XXE vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) lets a remote attacker read sensitive configuration information. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Nov 10 with a Nov 24 federal patch deadline. Fixed in BroadWorks release RI.2026.07; no workaround exists.
items.why_it_matters: BroadWorks underpins carrier and MSP voice platforms, so unpatched systems expose customer calling infrastructure. The vendor confirmation upgrades this from 'known exploited' to 'patch now' — use it to push stalled BroadWorks upgrades before the Nov 24 deadline.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigns effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
items.summary: NVIDIA's board announced on Nov 12 that co-founder, president and CEO Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress serves as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, considering internal and external candidates; Harvey Jones was appointed NVIDIA's first board chair. The resignation follows reports of Huang's relationships with a subordinate executive and with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence. NVIDIA says operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap continue without interruption. Shares fell about 4.3% to $166.19; earnings are due Nov 17.
items.why_it_matters: Leadership uncertainty at the vendor behind nearly every AI infrastructure deal. Expect customer questions about roadmap continuity and supply — NVIDIA's stated position is no interruption, but the CEO search and the Nov 17 earnings call are the next proof points. Don't speculate on succession in customer rooms.

items.title: Cohesity extends protection across Azure Blob, Data Lake and AKS, and pipes Gaia Catalog data into Databricks
items.summary: Announced Nov 12 at Microsoft Ignite: extended protection for Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage and Azure Kubernetes Service with application-consistent backups and granular Kubernetes recovery; Azure Government adds SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Table Storage and Cosmos DB. Entra ID recovery now covers permanently deleted objects synced to on-prem AD, with password reset on restore, plus Intune configuration objects. Gaia Catalog integration publishes curated backup data into Azure Databricks as an external data source while the data stays in Cohesity Data Cloud — no new ETL pipelines. GitHub and Azure DevOps protection is in preview.
items.why_it_matters: Strengthens Cohesity's Microsoft 365/Azure story against Rubrik and adds an AI-data angle: backup data becomes usable for analytics without copying it out. The Entra ID restore details are the discovery hook for identity-resilience conversations. Battlecard updated (Cohesity vs Rubrik).

items.title: Palo Alto Networks patches PAN-OS info-disclosure flaw CVE-2026-0331 (6.6)
items.summary: A security advisory published Nov 11 covers CVE-2026-0331: an unauthenticated attacker with network access can obtain sensitive firewall and session information through a dataplane interface. Affects PAN-OS 10.2 through 12.2 and Prisma Access 10.2, 11.2 and 12.1, with remediation thresholds published per release. Palo Alto Networks reports fiscal Q1 2027 results after market close on Nov 18.
items.why_it_matters: Medium severity, but unauthenticated and reachable via the dataplane — firewall customers should confirm they are on a fixed release. A good reason to check PAN-OS versions in upcoming calls.

items.title: Dell expands AI Data Platform with search and analytics engines, tighter NVIDIA integration
items.summary: Announced Nov 11: the AI Data Platform now combines storage engines (PowerScale, ObjectScale), data engines, cyber resilience and data management for AI training, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation and inference. New Data Search Engine built with Elastic supports natural-language queries across large file collections; a Data Analytics Engine built with Starburst connects spreadsheets, databases, cloud warehouses and lakehouses. PowerScale is being integrated with NVIDIA GB200 and GB300 NVL72 systems, and NVIDIA cuVS adds GPU-accelerated hybrid search.
items.why_it_matters: Dell's AI-storage pitch is now a full platform story — position PowerScale/ObjectScale as the data layer for RAG and inference, not just capacity. The Elastic and Starburst engines are the discovery questions for AI-data deals.

items.title: NC2 on AWS adds six Intel Xeon 6 bare-metal instance types
items.summary: Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) on AWS now supports six additional EC2 bare-metal instance types built on Intel Xeon 6 processors: c8id, m8id and r8id, each in metal-48xl and metal-96xl sizes. Requires AOS 7.5.1.x or later with AHV 11.0.1; availability varies by AWS region.
items.why_it_matters: More sizing options for hybrid-cloud and DR footprints on AWS — useful when right-sizing NC2 clusters. Check region availability before quoting a specific instance type.

items.title: HPE launches hybrid Cray E2000 storage and liquid-cooling rack controller for HPC/AI
items.summary: Announced Nov 12: new hybrid configurations of HPE Cray Supercomputing Storage Systems E2000 pair SSDs with new 32TB SAS-4 hard drives in enclosures holding 74 or 100 drives. HPE claims 41% more throughput per storage rack than competing DDN products, 82% lower cost than a comparable all-flash system, and up to 32% more usable capacity per rack. The new Rack Management Controller adds real-time monitoring, liquid-leak detection, automated controls and rack-level status management. E2000 hybrid configurations are planned for early 2027; the controller ships March 2027 for Cray GX systems, with AMD and NVIDIA rack-scale support in June 2027.
items.why_it_matters: An HPC/AI storage-economics pitch — hybrid flash plus high-density HDD at scale. Nothing ships until 2027, so this is a roadmap conversation for AI-infrastructure deals, not a quote-today item.

prompt_of_the_day.prompt: Draft a short, urgent outreach email to customers running clustered Cisco Expressway (Expressway-C / Expressway-E) about CVE-2026-76466: a critical hard-coded credential flaw (CVSS 9.8) in the cluster manager that lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach TCP port 4372 run commands as root. A public proof-of-concept and fleet detector went live on Nov 12, 2026; affected versions run through X15.5.3, fixed software is available, and there is no workaround. Keep it to 5 sentences: what the flaw is, who is exposed, what to do (patch to the fixed release, confirm no internet exposure of port 4372), and an offer to check their version and schedule the patch window this week. Tone: direct and helpful, no hype.
